koza-baptist-okinawa-city-jp.assessment: MOOP attended Koza Baptist Church during his Marine Corps stationing on Okinawa. Adam said 'Koza and Calvary Chapel mainly out there' — Koza Baptist is the dominant military-community Christian church in the Koza/Okinawa City area, planted in 1963 by SBC Foreign Mission Board. The current lead pastor Chris Eyre is himself a 30-year Marine Corps veteran which fits MOOP's profile precisely. Multi-elder polity, BFM2000 doctrinal frame, Japanese-translated services. Strong SBC work. GREEN.
